findings.description: The caption lists threshold_saddle among the extras, and no geometry for it exists anywhere on the door - not hidden, absent. (physics.py still charges hardware mass for several of these, so the door carries weight for parts that are not there.)
The caption says the pull_flush_recessed is on both sides. Only one face carries it: the other hardware close-up shows a blank leaf. A robot approaching from that side has nothing to take hold of.
